name: warm-longmemeval-s-500-v1
status: FROZEN for one held-out run; any edit after the first retrieval or API call voids the run

benchmark.reporting: report overall n=500 AND dev100 / heldout400 separately; dev100 was used for tuning, so the 500 figure mixes tuned and untouched questions

retrieval.granularity: flat user turn; each retrieved turn expands to its round (that turn plus the next turn)
retrieval.ranked_input: one JSON {question_id: [turn ids '<session_id>_<n>' best first]} with all 500 ids and the top 50 turns each; no label-bearing tie-breaks: ranking runs on ids replaced by sha256 of the turn id without its leading answer_/noans_ marker, ordered by that hash, so ties resolve by sha256 of the turn id
retrieval.producer: benchmarks/public/longmemeval_pipeline.py driven by benchmarks/public/longmemeval_modal.py --heldout-final on Modal: the pinned small Qwen3 models and the tuned benchmarks/public/longmemeval_config.json at pinned_warm_revision; rankings from retrieval scores only (pipeline.blinded_rankings), written as <tag>.rankings.json

pipeline.entrypoint_flags: --dataset s --part all --models small --engine python --cap 12 --tag lme500 --heldout-final benchmarks/public/longmemeval_500_frozen_config.json --frozen-sha256 <sha256 of this file>
pipeline.note: dev100 tuned this config; the held-out 400 are first scored by this run

reader.protocol: official run_generation.py flat-turn, json history, chain-of-note (con) template, history chats sorted by session date, has_answer stripped
reader.api_mode: sync; the OpenRouter proxy serves neither streaming nor the Batch API, so --batch is not used

abstention.rule: No reader-side abstention rule, threshold or label. The reader abstains only by saying so in its own answer.
abstention.judge_side: the official judge switches to the unanswerable prompt iff '_abs' in question_id; this is judge-only and never reaches retrieval or the reader

judges.how: python evaluate_qa.py gpt-4o-mini <hypotheses.jsonl> longmemeval_s_cleaned.json (official, unchanged); required by the Engram board; reported separately, never averaged with the primary

repeats: single pass; temperature 0 is not deterministic (about 6 of 100 dev questions flipped between repeated k=10 runs), so the figure is one sample, not a bound

spend.api: reader and judges via OpenRouter with the provider pinned to OpenAI (allow_fallbacks=false) through the local proxy /Volumes/A/.hms-lb/longmemeval/openrouter/proxy.py; responses from any other provider are rejected; models gpt-4o-2024-08-06 and gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18; no other provider
spend.authorization: none granted by this file; the maintainer runs it

forbidden: tuning any value in this file after the first held-out API call
selecting k, prompts or reader after seeing 500-question results
dropping failed or empty questions from the denominator
editing any tracked file after pinned_warm_revision other than this config, or running from a dirty tree
